hooks.command: { [ -n "$CC_NOTIF_CLASSIFIER" ] && exit 0; input=$(cat); msg=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.message // "Claude needs your input"'); sid=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.session_id // empty'); name=$(jq -r --arg sid "$sid" 'select(.sessionId == $sid and .kind == "interactive") | .name // empty' "$HOME"/.claude/sessions/*.json 2>/dev/null | head -1); [ -n "$name" ] && { mkdir -p "$HOME"/.claude/state/waiting && touch "$HOME"/.claude/state/waiting/"$sid"; if [ -n "$TMUX_PANE" ]; then click="/opt/homebrew/bin/tmux switch-client -t $TMUX_PANE; /opt/homebrew/bin/tmux select-window -t $TMUX_PANE; /opt/homebrew/bin/tmux select-pane -t $TMUX_PANE; /opt/homebrew/bin/tmux set -p -t $TMUX_PANE window-style bg=#7a5c00; sleep 0.7; /opt/homebrew/bin/tmux set -p -t $TMUX_PANE window-style bg=#6e5505; sleep 0.12; /opt/homebrew/bin/tmux set -p -t $TMUX_PANE window-style bg=#634d09; sleep 0.12; /opt/homebrew/bin/tmux set -p -t $TMUX_PANE window-style bg=#58460e; sleep 0.12; /opt/homebrew/bin/tmux set -p -t $TMUX_PANE window-style bg=#4c3f13; sleep 0.12; /opt/homebrew/bin/tmux set -p -t $TMUX_PANE window-style bg=#413717; sleep 0.12; /opt/homebrew/bin/tmux set -pu -t $TMUX_PANE window-style"; else click=true; fi; /opt/homebrew/bin/terminal-notifier -title "Claude Code — $name" -message "$msg" -activate "${__CFBundleIdentifier:-com.mitchellh.ghostty}" -execute "$click"; }; } 2>/dev/null || true

{ sid=$(jq -r ".session_id // empty"); [ -n "$sid" ] && rm -f "$HOME"/.claude/state/waiting/"$sid"; [ -n "$TMUX_PANE" ] && /opt/homebrew/bin/tmux set -pu -t "$TMUX_PANE" window-style; } 2>/dev/null; true

{ [ -n "$CC_NOTIF_CLASSIFIER" ] && exit 0; input=$(cat); printf '%s\n' "$input" >> "$HOME"/.claude/debug/stop-hook-payloads.jsonl; sid=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.session_id // empty'); name=$(jq -r --arg sid "$sid" 'select(.sessionId == $sid and .kind == "interactive") | .name // empty' "$HOME"/.claude/sessions/*.json 2>/dev/null | head -1); [ -z "$name" ] && exit 0; cd "$HOME"/.claude/notify-classifier-home; verdict=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -c '{running_background_tasks: ((.background_tasks // []) | map(select(.status == "running")) | length), task_descriptions: ((.background_tasks // []) | map(select(.status == "running") | .description[0:60])), final_message: (.last_assistant_message // "" | .[-1500:])}' | CC_NOTIF_CLASSIFIER=1 CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BUNDLED_SKILLS=1 "$HOME"/.bun/bin/claude -p --model haiku --strict-mcp-config --no-session-persistence --settings '{"disableAllHooks":true}' "$(cat "$HOME"/.claude/notify-classifier-prompt.txt)"); case "$verdict" in NOTIFY*) mkdir -p "$HOME"/.claude/state/waiting && touch "$HOME"/.claude/state/waiting/"$sid"; if [ -n "$TMUX_PANE" ]; then click="/opt/homebrew/bin/tmux switch-client -t $TMUX_PANE; /opt/homebrew/bin/tmux select-window -t $TMUX_PANE; /opt/homebrew/bin/tmux select-pane -t $TMUX_PANE; /opt/homebrew/bin/tmux set -p -t $TMUX_PANE window-style bg=#7a5c00; sleep 0.7; /opt/homebrew/bin/tmux set -p -t $TMUX_PANE window-style bg=#6e5505; sleep 0.12; /opt/homebrew/bin/tmux set -p -t $TMUX_PANE window-style bg=#634d09; sleep 0.12; /opt/homebrew/bin/tmux set -p -t $TMUX_PANE window-style bg=#58460e; sleep 0.12; /opt/homebrew/bin/tmux set -p -t $TMUX_PANE window-style bg=#4c3f13; sleep 0.12; /opt/homebrew/bin/tmux set -p -t $TMUX_PANE window-style bg=#413717; sleep 0.12; /opt/homebrew/bin/tmux set -pu -t $TMUX_PANE window-style"; else click=true; fi; /opt/homebrew/bin/terminal-notifier -title "Claude Code — $name" -message "Waiting for you" -activate "${__CFBundleIdentifier:-com.mitchellh.ghostty}" -execute "$click";; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
